name: Topology-aware mesh quality improvement for Marching Cubes 33
aliases: Labelle and Shewchuk integration with Extended MC33
definition: A method to improve the aspect ratio of triangulations generated by Marching Cubes 33 by modifying scalar field values near isosurface intersections, while preventing topological errors using a verification step.
summary: This method improves Marching Cubes 33 mesh quality by removing skinny triangles while preserving topology, unlike Raman and Wenger which fails at lambda zero.
